title: Mini marrow mix | Voskes
heading: MINI MARROW MIX
description: Mix of small marrow biscuits particularly suitable for puppies from 6 months and adult dogs of small breeds. Enriched with vitamins A, D3 and E.
bodyDescription: Mix of small marrow biscuits particularly suitable for puppies from 6 months and adult dogs of small breeds.These delicious, crunchy biscuits can be given as a reward during training or simply as a snack to spoil your four-legged friend. Also ideal during the daily walk. Moreover, the biscuits are enriched with vitamins A, D3 and E!
